items.title: Trustworthy agents in practice
items.decision: catalog-only addition, optional tier under Safety & Governance's goDeeper (or Agents, either fits). Not required reading: the piece itself flags several claims (MCP benefits, subagent coordination patterns) as exploratory with no results presented, so evidence quality is mixed, not uniformly strong.
